findings.highlight: the strategy that the two of them had discussed and settled upon, around three years ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 三年ぶりくらいに、二人きりで話し合って決めた作戦
findings.explanation: Io and Takeya have just discussed this one-on-one for the first time in roughly three years; the translation says they devised the strategy around three years ago.
findings.japanese:
「五人…？」

「あたしたちがいるよ、雪菜。あたしと、武也がさ」

「依緒…」

　雪菜の気持ちが溢れるに任せ。

　雪菜の涙が溢れるに任せ。

　嗚咽が徐々にゆっくり、そして小さく萎んでいった頃。

　依緒は、雪菜に囁きかけた。

「だから、今まで通り『春希くん』でいいよ。『雪菜』って呼ばれてもいいよ」

「い、いいの…？」

「けどさ、もっと緩い気持ちで繋がればいいんだよ」

　武也が春希にしたのと同じ…

　というか、三年ぶりくらいに、二人きりで話し合って決めた作戦を伝えた。

「そこに春希がいればいいんだろ？　冬馬さんがいればいいんだよね？」
findings.todokanai:
“Five…?”

“We’ll be there, Setsuna. Takeya and I will.”

“Io…”

Setsuna let her feelings overflow.

Let her tears overflow.

Her crying fit gradually slowed, and when it had tapered off…

Io murmured to Setsuna.

“You can keep calling him ‘Haruki-kun.’ You can keep being ‘Setsuna’ to him.”

“I… I can…?”

“But you have to loosen up a little bit in your connection with him.”

Just as Takeya said to Haruki…

Or, really, she was passing on the strategy that the two of them had discussed and settled upon, around three years ago.

“You’ll be glad to have Haruki there, right? And Touma-san?”

findings.highlight: Because this was something Setsuna had done long ago.
findings.evidenceJa: もう雪菜には、遠い過去の出来事なのだから
findings.explanation: The narration declares that these destructive patterns will now be a distant past for Setsuna after her vow. The translation instead claims they happened long ago, contradicting the scene's just-completed change.
findings.japanese:
「ぃぅっ、ぅ、ぁ…ぅぇぇぇぇ…っ」

　雪菜は、また涙を流す。

　今度は嗚咽なんて生易しいものではなく、喉から絞り出すような号泣だった。

「ふぇぇぇぇぇっ、依緒、わたし…あぁぁぁぁぁぁ～っ！」

　けれどもう、それは後悔の涙ではなく…

　二度と後戻りはしないと誓う、前向きな涙。

「雪菜…あんた、今よりもっといい女になるよ。男なら誰でも振り返るような、完璧なアイドルにさ」

　必死に三人にしがみつくことも。

　三人から二人、抜け出そうとすることも。

　二人でいることから逃げて、一人になってしまうことも。

　もう雪菜には、遠い過去の出来事なのだから。
findings.todokanai:
“Ah… aaaah…”

Setsuna let her tears flow again.

This time, it wasn’t anything so simple as a crying fit—this was wailing, wrung all the way from her throat.

“Io, I… Aaaaaah…!”

But these weren’t tears of regret…

They were forward-facing tears, an oath that she would never turn back again.

“Setsuna… You’re gonna end up an even better girl than you are now. A perfect idol, who would turn any guy’s head.”

Never cling desperately to the “trio” again.

Never try to break two of them out of the trio again.

Never run away from being two, and end up alone again.

Because this was something Setsuna had done long ago.
